testimonials.text: I found the detailed comparison between subpectoral and prepectoral implant-based reconstruction, as well as the in-depth discussion of autologous flap options, particularly interesting. The step-by-step surgical techniques, anatomical considerations, and management of complications provided a comprehensive understanding that was both practical and clinically relevant.
A complex topic is well-explained in a very organized manner.
I have learnt new things and different types of reconstructive surgery were the most interesting.
The new information I have accumulated, and it has brought me a deeper passion for plastic surgery.
